title: the middle-dot / colon glue inside a tblW-auto column follows the run's East Asian language
source: probe build.py (A4 9026-twip column, Calibri 11, cell margins 108, 600 + 8400 tcW), Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf vertical rules; the harness measures with the 0.52em heuristic, so the tolerances cover heuristic-vs-Calibri advance drift while keeping the glued, half-glued and broken cases apart

cases.note: no w:lang w:eastAsia: 'mmmm \u00b7 mmmm' is one word (Word 90.5 pt = whole string + margins)
zh-CN: the same whole-string column (Word 90.5 pt)
zh-TW: the dot may end a line but not start one -> 'mmmm \u00b7' + margins (Word 51.4 pt)
pt-BR: plain spaces, the column is one 'mmmm' + margins (Word 46.1 pt)
pt-BR 'mmmm : mmmm': the colon no longer glues (Word 46.1 pt)
